BEN OTTO

About Me

AT WORK

How I work.

I’m at my best when I have something to build and a result to own.

I like getting close to the work: talking to customers, understanding what the team needs, and turning that into a clear direction. My career has involved building sales teams, opening markets, developing brokerage partnerships, and creating a revenue organization from founder-led selling.

I want the responsibility to shape the plan and see it through. Developing people and building relationships are central to that. At Side, the work I loved was getting to know exceptional agents, understanding their ambitions, and helping them build businesses they believed in.

OUTSIDE WORK

A little about me.

My wife and I live in Northern Virginia with our dog, Teddy, a wirehaired pointing griffon. We’re looking forward to making the NYC / Connecticut area our next home.

I grew up in a small Massachusetts town with parents who were swim coaches, and I went on to swim at UMass Amherst. These days, basketball and swimming are still two things I enjoy. I also spend time woodworking and sketching, and I like having a project I can make with my hands.
